message.content: {"items":[{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) 2013 – Campaign Panel","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11920","justification":"Major GESIS study of political behaviour and attitudes during the 2013 federal election campaign in Germany, with repeated surveys capturing vote intentions, party evaluations, and campaign perceptions."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) 2017 – Pre- and Post-election Cross-Section","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12912","justification":"Nationally representative GESIS dataset on political attitudes and voting behaviour around the 2017 Bundestag election, including party preferences, issue positions, and turnout."},{"title":"Politbarometer Trend (Cumulated) 2010–2019","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13526","justification":"Long-running GESIS cumulation of the German Politbarometer surveys covering the 2010s, with regular measures of vote intention, party identification, government satisfaction, and political attitudes."},{"title":"European Social Survey (ESS) – Germany, Round 5 (2010)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11448","justification":"GESIS-distributed ESS round including the German sample for 2010, rich on political trust, participation, and attitudinal indicators for Germany at the start of the 2010s."},{"title":"European Social Survey (ESS) – Germany, Round 8 (2016)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13165","justification":"ESS round with the German subsample in the mid‑2010s, capturing political interest, trust, ideological self‑placement, and participation patterns."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 2010","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11011","justification":"GESIS ALLBUS wave including modules on political interest, party identification, trust in institutions and democracy, enabling analysis of political attitudes in Germany in 2010."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 2012","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11560","justification":"National survey by GESIS containing detailed indicators of political orientations, party ties, and democratic attitudes for Germany in the early 2010s."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 2014","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12213","justification":"MID‑2010s ALLBUS wave with extensive measures of political interest, values, and party preferences among the German population."},{"title":"German General Social Survey (ALLBUS) 2018","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13271","justification":"Late‑2010s ALLBUS study including questions on political behaviour, trust in political institutions, and party identification in Germany."},{"title":"German Longitudinal Election Study (GLES) 2013 – Rolling Cross-Section Campaign Survey","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.11922","justification":"Daily rolling cross‑section survey conducted by GESIS during the 2013 federal election campaign, designed to study short‑term dynamics in political attitudes and vote intentions in Germany."}]}
